From Geospatial Data to Action: Geo Sessions 2026 Puts GeoAI to the Operational Test

2026-10-05 Edoardo Carlucci, Rivista Geomedia Geo Sessions 2026, GeoAI, SAR, LiDAR, spectral analysis, BIM, CAD, GIS, Earth Observation, infrastructure monitoring, NV5
Read the source article

Quick summary

Geo Sessions 2026, organized by NV5 Geospatial Software on October 14-15, explores how GeoAI, SAR, LiDAR and spectral technologies are moving from research to operational use across BIM, CAD, GIS, Earth Observation and infrastructure monitoring.

Key takeaways

  • Geo Sessions 2026 takes place October 14-15, 2026, online with free registration
  • The event focuses on putting GeoAI to the "operational test" — moving from research to real-world applications
  • Technologies covered include SAR (Synthetic Aperture Radar), LiDAR, and spectral analysis
  • Application domains span BIM, CAD, GIS, Earth Observation, Earth Sciences, and infrastructure monitoring
  • The event is organized by NV5 Geospatial Software
  • The focus is on the full pipeline from geospatial data collection to actionable intelligence
